realBrowserFailure.scope: Actual Chrome English Carbon at 1280 by 720. The committed blank welcome occupied the canvas while a real data candidate was previewed.

before.assertion: Welcome must not squeeze an actual blank-canvas preview

checks: A valid resource comparison hides the welcome area temporarily
A normal UI refresh keeps the active comparison area available
Cancel restores the welcome for the current committed blank
A previously dismissed welcome stays dismissed
Project, state, history and dismissal preference remain exact

fix: The temporary resource-preview box owns a showing flag. Painting hides welcome before measuring fit; restoration clears the flag before fitting the committed canvas.
limits: Controlled DOM lifecycle does not establish actual browser dimensions or scientific drawing accuracy.
Actual corrected-source and installed Windows retests remain pending.
